cases.evidence_note: T-101. stage5.return.refund (standard deduction, no investment interest, no 2024 carryforward, no line 4g) with both Form 4952 screens answered Yes. Before the change Form 1040 lines 12e and 24 to 37 were refused (f4952.unsupported). Predicted from f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: Form 4952 is not used, so neither screen is reached and every Form 1040 value of stage5.return.refund is unchanged; Form 4952 line 8 is $0. Written before the evaluator was run.

T-101. stage5.return.refund (single, Form 1040 line 11b $130,000) with f8960.unsupported answered Yes. Predicted from i8960 p. 1, Who Must File, "Attach Form 8960 to your return if your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) is greater than the applicable threshold amount" ($200,000, line 14) and p. 22, Line 13 (MAGI is AGI; the section 911 exclusion and CFC and PFIC inclusions are refused elsewhere): Form 8960 is not filed, line 16 and line 17 are $0 and every Form 1040 value of stage5.return.refund is unchanged. Before the change Form 1040 lines 23, 24 and 37 were refused (T-101 witness). The Form 1040 values are those recorded for stage5.return.refund; the evaluator was run on this case before and after the change while the narrowing was developed, before this fixture was written; the expectation (no Form 1040 value changes) follows from the source as stated.

Predicted from the source before evaluation: i8960 p. 1, Who Must File, attach Form 8960 "if your MAGI is greater than the applicable threshold amount" ($200,000 single). With wages and AGI exactly $200,000 the form is not filed even though f8960.unsupported is answered Yes, so f8960.line16 is $0 and the return completes; Form 1040 line 23 is $0 (no net investment income tax, and no Additional Medicare Tax because Medicare wages of $200,000 are not more than the $200,000 threshold, i8959). Kills the mutation boundary.f8960.f8960.used (greater than made inclusive).

T-101. stage5.return.refund (single, Form 1040 line 11b $130,000) with f8960.refund answered Yes. A deduction recovery changes only net investment income (i8960 pp. 14-15); predicted from i8960 p. 1, Who Must File, "Attach Form 8960 to your return if your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) is greater than the applicable threshold amount" ($200,000): Form 8960 is not filed, line 16 and line 17 are $0 and every Form 1040 value of stage5.return.refund is unchanged. Before the change Form 1040 lines 23, 24 and 37 were refused (T-101 witness). The Form 1040 values are those recorded for stage5.return.refund; the evaluator was run on this case before and after the change while the narrowing was developed, before this fixture was written; the expectation (no Form 1040 value changes) follows from the source as stated.

T-101. stage5.return.refund (no dependents) with s8812.combat_pay answered Yes. Predicted from Schedule 8812 line 12, "No. Stop here. You cannot take the child tax credit, credit for other dependents, or additional child tax credit": line 27 and Form 1040 line 28 are $0 and every Form 1040 value of stage5.return.refund is unchanged; EIC and Form 2441, which also read the gate, are not used on this return. Before the change Form 1040 lines 23, 24 and 37 were refused (T-101 witness). The Form 1040 values are those recorded for stage5.return.refund; the evaluator was run on this case before and after the change while the narrowing was developed, before this fixture was written; the expectation (no Form 1040 value changes) follows from the source as stated.
